description: Figure 2, titled "Performance with different chunking sizes," is a line plot illustrating how performance, measured on the y-axis, varies with the "Number of Tokens" on the x-axis for four distinct document sources. The x-axis is a linear scale ranging from 200 to 1000, with major tick marks at intervals of 200. The y-axis, representing performance, is also linear, scaled from 10 to 40, with major ticks every 10 units. The plot displays four lines, each corresponding to a different source as indicated in the legend: "Tutorials" (blue line with circle markers), "Library Documentation" (red line with circle markers), "StackOverflow posts" (yellow line with circle markers), and "Github files" (green line with circle markers). The "Tutorials" line starts at approximately 24 at 200 tokens, rises to a peak of about 30 at 800 tokens, and then slightly declines to 28 at 1000 tokens. The "Library Documentation" line begins at roughly 27, peaks at 31 at 800 tokens, and ends at 29. The "StackOverflow posts" line shows a consistent downward trend, starting at 33 and falling to 12 by 1000 tokens. The "Github files" line starts at 29, increases to 33 at 800 tokens, and then drops to 30 at 1000 tokens.
